# Normalize text

Run scripts/skill.py --help for discovery. Supply --input-json with a text string.

artifact.source:
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# dependencies = []
# ///
import argparse
import json
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Normalize text deterministically")
parser.add_argument('--input-json', required=True, help='JSON object with one string field: text')
args = parser.parse_args()
value = json.loads(args.input_json)
if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {'text'} or not isinstance(value['text'], str):
    parser.error('Expected exactly one string field: text')
print(value['text'].strip().lower())
